card.title: Hope with Me
card.instruction: Recruit someone into believing that the outcome can still change, even when the evidence is thin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Draw another route for our parade with me. Two streets said no; the town hasn't.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The only route left goes behind the supermarket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then take the other pencil. Can you picture people cheering by the loading bay?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My dad would come. He works there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put him on the map. Where would a second person stand?

mechanism: A recruits B into imagining a viable parade from a poor route and a single possible spectator.
confusable: Unlike private optimism, A must get another person to participate in picturing how the outcome could improve.
comparison: D103-a maps the first and next spectator; D103-b chooses a mother's mug as an imagined first cafe customer.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
